name: bugs-welcome-messages-339711-339712-339714-how-to-verify
title: How to verify 3 Agents window welcome message fixes · Insiders from Oct 15 or newer

setup.label: SET UP
setup.do: Agents window: ⇧⌘P Preferences: Open Application Settings (JSON), the Default profile's settings.json (these settings are application-scoped).

b1.label: #339711 · 1 OF 3
b1.do: Set this; New Session (⌘N) twice. Test Name replaces each `${name}` with no stray `$` left.

b2.label: #339712 · 2 OF 3
b2.do: Set this, then reload a few times (⇧⌘P Developer: Reload Window). Each reload shows the next phrase; yours come after the 5 built-in ones. The title's `welcomeName` means `welcomeMessages` here.

b3.label: #339714 · 3 OF 3
b3.do: Set this: no welcome message, also after a reload (⇧⌘P Developer: Reload Window). The input still works.

cleanup.label: CLEANUP
cleanup.do: Remove these from Application Settings (JSON), or restore your own.
